content.short: Gnosis V2 is an open-source archive of Gnosis V2 smart contracts for developers to review.
content.description: Gnosis V2 is an open-source repository of smart contracts for Gnosis version 2. Developers can reuse the code as templates, draw inspiration, or study it as learning material to help build stronger smart contracts. The project is archived, but a newer branch remains available for ongoing work. The original team behind the project continues to contribute updates to the codebase, keeping it current and useful as a reference.
